type MissingOptions = {trace: boolean};
async function inOrder<T>(items: T[], step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, options: MissingOptions) {

 for (const item of items) { await step(item); }
}
async function inOrderSteps(steps: (() => Promise<void>)[], options: MissingOptions) {

 for (const step of steps) { await step(); }
}
